display.text:
name: Android APK Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'code/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('code/gradle.properties', 'code/gradle-wrapper.jar') }}

      - name: Grant execute permission for gradlew
        run: chmod +x code/gradlew

      - name: Build Debug APK
        working-directory: code
        run: ./gradlew assembleDebug

      - name: Upload Debug APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zen-panel-debug-apk
          path: code/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk

      - name: Build Release APK
        working-directory: code
        run: |
          echo "Keystore not configured - skipping release build"
          echo "To build release, add keystore to code/keystore/ and set properties in gradle.properties"

      - name: Release Please (optional)
        if: false
        run: |
          echo "Create GitHub Release manually or configure release-please"

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<ScrollView xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:fillViewport="true"
    android:background="@color/bg">

    <LinearLayout
        android:layout_width="match_parent"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="vertical"
        android:padding="20dp">

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
            android:text="@string/app_name"
            android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
            android:textSize="26sp"
            android:textStyle="bold" />

        <TextView
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="20dp"
            android:text="@string/panel_subtitle"
            android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
            android:textSize="14sp" />

        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card"
            app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/border"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="20dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
                    android:text="@string/features_title"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                    android:textSize="16sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold" />

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/feature_cache"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                    android:textSize="14sp" />

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/feature_notifications"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                    android:textSize="14sp" />

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/feature_storage"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                    android:textSize="14sp" />

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/feature_search"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                    android:textSize="14sp" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card"
            app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/border"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="20dp">

                <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:hint="@string/search_hint"
                    app:boxBackgroundColor="@color/input_bg"
                    app:boxStrokeColor="@color/border">

                    <com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText
                        android:id="@+id/inputSearch"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:imeOptions="actionSearch"
                        android:inputType="text"
                        android:maxLines="1"
                        android:textColor="@color/text_primary" />
                </com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputLayout>

                <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                    android:id="@+id/buttonSearch"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                    android:text="@string/search_button"
                    android:textAllCaps="false"
                    app:backgroundTint="@color/primary" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card"
            app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/border"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="20dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
                    android:text="@string/status_title"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                    android:textSize="16sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold" />

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/textStatus"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
                    android:text="@string/status_online"
                    android:textColor="@color/status_online"
                    android:textSize="15sp" />

                <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                    android:id="@+id/buttonTestNotification"
                    style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TonalButton"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:text="@string/test_notification"
                    android:textAllCaps="false" />

                <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                    android:id="@+id/buttonLaunchExtension"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    android:text="@string/launch_extension"
                    android:textAllCaps="false"
                    app:backgroundTint="@color/primary" />

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    android:gravity="center_vertical"
                    android:orientation="horizontal">

                    <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                        android:id="@+id/buttonBrowsec"
                        style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TonalButton"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="@string/browsec"
                        android:textAllCaps="false" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/textBrowsecStatus"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginStart="12dp"
                        android:text="@string/browsec_off"
                        android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                        android:textSize="13sp" />
                </LinearLayout>
            </LinearLayout>
        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card"
            app:cardCornerRadius="8dp"
            app:strokeColor="@color/border"
            app:strokeWidth="1dp">

            <LinearLayout
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:padding="20dp">

                <TextView
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
                    android:text="@string/traffic_title"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                    android:textSize="16sp"
                    android:textStyle="bold" />

                <TextView
                    android:id="@+id/textTraffic"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:fontFamily="monospace"
                    android:text="@string/traffic_empty"
                    android:textColor="@color/text_muted"
                    android:textSize="13sp" />

                <com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton
                    android:id="@+id/buttonClearLog"
                    style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TextButton"
                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                    android:text="@string/clear_log"
                    android:textAllCaps="false" />
            </LinearLayout>
        </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
    </LinearLayout>
</ScrollView>

They want me to explain what each of my proposed options actually looks like / is. Let me explain the two variants concretely: fully native UI vs WebView wrapper. Describe architecture, features, pros/cons, and what the resulting app would be.

Let me be clear and structured but concise-ish. Given this is an explanation request, I can be a bit longer than 4 lines. Let me describe based on the actual PWA content.

Let me explain both options concretely in terms of this specific app (Zen Panel).

Option A — full native Kotlin UI (classic Views/Material): 
- MainActivity native screen with cards: features list, search box, status, buttons.
- Uses ConnectivityManager for online/offline, NotificationManager/NotificationCompat for push with POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission, SharedPreferences for storage and traffic log, Intent ACTION_VIEW to open Google search, second Activity as extension simulator.
- No WebView; UI built in XML + Kotlin.
- Result: a normal Android app, APK ~ a few MB, no HTML.
- Pros: fast, looks/feels native, no browser dependency, works offline, easy Play-style packaging. Cons: UI is a re-creation, not pixel-identical to PWA; any new PWA feature must be re-implemented.

Option B — WebView wrapper over the existing PWA:
- Single Activity with a WebView. PWA files copied into app/src/main/assets/www, loaded via WebViewAssetLoader (https://appassets.androidplatform.net) so service worker / relative paths work.
- A JS bridge (addJavascriptInterface) exposes native functions: showNotification, getNetworkStatus, toggleBrowsec, openSearch.
- Extension simulator stays a page inside the WebView.
- Result: APK that looks exactly like the PWA inside an app shell; native Android handles notifications/permissions.
- Pros: fast to build, 1:1 with PWA, easy to update (edit HTML). Cons: hybrid, not "true" native; WebView perf; some PWA APIs (service worker) finicky.

I should also mention what the app does (features) since they asked "что из себя приложение представляет". And maybe note that the app itself is small — a panel mock: features list, Google search, notifications test, browsec toggle, extension simulator. No real VNC/terminals/git despite release notes.

class VpnManager(private val appContext: Context) {

package com.zenpanel.app

import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.zenpanel.app.databinding.ActivityServerListBinding
import com.zenpanel.app.databinding.DialogAddServerBinding

class ServerListActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var binding: ActivityServerListBinding
    private lateinit var app: App
    private lateinit var adapter: ServerAdapter

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        binding = ActivityServerListBinding.inflate(layoutInflater)
        setContentView(binding.root)

        app = application as App

        binding.recyclerServers.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(this)
        render()

        binding.buttonAddServer.setOnClickListener { showAddDialog() }
    }

    private fun render() {
        val selectedId = app.servers.selectedId
        adapter = ServerAdapter(
            servers = app.servers.all(),
            selectedId = selectedId,
            onSelect = { server ->
                app.servers.selectedId = server.id
                render()
                toast(getString(R.string.server_selected, server.displayName()))
            },
            onDelete = { server ->
                app.servers.remove(server.id)
                render()
            }
        )
        binding.recyclerServers.adapter = adapter
        binding.textEmpty.visibility =
            if (app.servers.all().isEmpty()) android.view.View.VISIBLE else android.view.View.GONE
    }

    private fun showAddDialog() {
        val dialogBinding = DialogAddServerBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(this))
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.server_add_title)
            .setView(dialogBinding.root)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.server_add_save) { _, _ ->
                val config = dialogBinding.inputConfig.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                if (config.isBlank()) {
                    toast(getString(R.string.server_config_required))
                    return@setPositiveButton
                }
                val countryCode = dialogBinding.inputCountryCode.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                val server = VpnServer(
                    name = dialogBinding.inputName.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
                        .ifBlank { getString(R.string.server_default_name) },
                    country = dialogBinding.inputCountry.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty(),
                    countryCode = countryCode,
                    config = config
                )
                app.servers.add(server)
                render()
            }
            .setNegativeButton(R.string.close, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun toast(message: String) {
        Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }
}

name: Android APK Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'code/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-apk:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('code/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties', 'code/**/*.gradle.kts') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-

      - name: Grant execute permission for gradlew
        run: chmod +x code/gradlew

      - name: Build Debug APK
        working-directory: code
        run: ./gradlew assembleDebug --stacktrace

      - name: Upload Debug APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zen-panel-debug-apk
          path: code/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk

      - name: Build Release APK (unsigned)
        working-directory: code
        run: ./gradlew assembleRelease --stacktrace

      - name: Upload Release APK (unsigned)
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: zen-panel-release-apk-unsigned
          path: code/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk

name: Zen Panel Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version without leading v (e.g. 1.0.1)'
        required: true

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Cache Gradle
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.gradle/caches
            ~/.gradle/wrapper
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('code/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties', 'code/**/*.gradle.kts') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-

      - name: Grant execute permission for gradlew
        run: chmod +x code/gradlew

      - name: Decode release keystore (if configured)
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "No KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret set; release build will be unsigned."
            exit 0
          fi
          mkdir -p code/keystore
          echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > code/keystore/release.jks
          {
            echo "storeFile=keystore/release.jks"
            echo "storePassword=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"
            echo "keyAlias=$KEY_ALIAS"
            echo "keyPassword=$KEY_PASSWORD"
          } > code/keystore.properties
          echo "Release keystore configured."

      - name: Determine version
        id: ver
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            echo "version=${{ github.event.inputs.version }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "version=${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Build release APK
        working-directory: code
        run: ./gradlew assembleRelease --stacktrace

      - name: Assemble release assets
        run: |
          set -e
          RELEASE_DIR="$(pwd)/release-assets"
          mkdir -p "$RELEASE_DIR"
          cp code/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk "$RELEASE_DIR"/
          (cd pwa && zip -r "$RELEASE_DIR/zen-panel-pwa.zip" . >/dev/null)
          ls -la "$RELEASE_DIR"

      - name: Write release notes
        run: |
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release_notes.md" <<'EOF'
          ## Zen Panel

          ### Artifacts
          - `app-release.apk` - signed native Android app (WireGuard VPN)
          - `zen-panel-pwa.zip` - static PWA files

          ### Features
          - Native Kotlin UI (Material 3, dark theme)
          - Real VPN via WireGuard userspace backend (VpnService + route table)
          - Server list with country selection and user-supplied WireGuard configs
          - Live traffic counters and speed read from wireguard-go
          - Foreground notification with country and current speed
          - Google Search, network status, local traffic log, extension simulator

          ### Install
          1. Download `app-release.apk` below and install it.
          2. Add your own WireGuard config: Servers -> Add server.
          3. Pick a server and tap Connect.
          EOF

      - name: Create or update GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.ver.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -e
          TAG="v$VERSION"
          if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" release-assets/* --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" \
              --title "$TAG - Zen Panel" \
              --notes-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/release_notes.md" \
              release-assets/*
          fi

Server is up. Now create the client config for the app.

Client config:
```
[Interface]
PrivateKey = <client.key>
Address = 10.13.13.2/24
MTU = 1280

[Peer]
PublicKey = <server.pub>
AllowedIPs = 0.0.0.0/0
Endpoint = 10.0.2.2:51820
PersistentKeepalive = 25
```

Actually to also test IPv6? The server only has IPv4 (wireguard-go created wg0 with fe80 link-local). Client AllowedIPs 0.0.0.0/0 only (drop ::/0 to avoid issues). DNS: set to 1.1.1.1. But if I set DNS, the WireGuard backend will configure a DNS server on the VPN; resolution queries will go through tunnel to 1.1.1.1, which via NAT reaches internet. Fine. But to keep test simpler, maybe skip DNS (then the app uses system DNS, which would go through the tunnel too due to 0.0.0.0/0). Actually with AllowedIPs 0.0.0.0/0, DNS to whatever the system resolver is will also be tunneled. For a clean "real internet" test we can set DNS = 1.1.1.1.

Let me write the client config file.

Now create AVD and boot emulator. Let me check memory first.

Let me create AVD.

avdmanager create avd -n zen -k "system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64" -d pixel_5 --force

Needs `echo no |` to answer "Do you wish to create a custom hardware profile?".

Then boot emulator.

Memory concern: Let me check free. The emulator default RAM for pixel_5 is 2048. We can pass -memory 2048. If OOM, reduce to 1536.

Let me create AVD and boot.

I'll launch the emulator with setsid nohup, redirect to log, so the bash tool returns.

Command:
```
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$ANDROID_HOME
echo no | avdmanager create avd -n zen -k "system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64" -d pixel_5 --force
setsid nohup $ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator -avd zen -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot -gpu swiftshader_indirect -memory 2048 -no-metrics -port 5554 >/tmp/opencode/emu.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
```

Then wait for boot.

Let me run AVD creation first.

Actually, on this container without KVM access for the runner user? /dev/kvm is group kvm, and runner is in group... groups listed: adm, users, docker, systemd-journal. No kvm group. So runner can't access /dev/kvm. But we have sudo. We could run emulator as root, or add runner to kvm group (sudo usermod -aG kvm runner) — but group change needs new login. We could just `sudo chmod 666 /dev/kvm` or run emulator with `sudo`. Running emulator as root is messy (adb, files). Simpler: `sudo chmod 666 /dev/kvm` so runner can use it. Let me do that.

Also need /dev/kvm accessible. Let me chmod.

Alternatively, run emulator without KVM (software) with `-accel off` — very slow, might not boot in reasonable time. Better use KVM.

Let me chmod /dev/kvm and create AVD.
